# bosk_node (Data Source)

Reads the value at a path in a bosk state tree.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bosk_node" "targets" {
  path = "/targets"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Path of the node below the provider's maintenance endpoint, beginning with `/`.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) Opaque ETag returned by bosk for nodes that have a `revision` field.
- `value` (String) JSON-encoded value of the node.
